_comment: isiXhosa draft from Notion R8 (xh part 1 + part 2), imported verbatim. Native-speaker review required; the language stays labelled beta. Keys added later are an API draft generated through the Anthropic API (2026-10-24).
english_only_note: Ezinye izikrini zisabonisa isiNgesi ngelixa iinguqulelo zijongwa.
auth_check_email: Jonga i-imeyile yakho ukuze uqinisekise iakhawunti, uze ungene.
auth_error: Asikwazanga ukukungenisa. Jonga i-imeyile negama lokugqitha.
consent_body: UZaka usebenzisa iinkcukacha zemali ozifakayo ukubonisa uqikelelo lokungena nokuphuma kwemali nokuchaza imingcipheko enokwenzeka. Ungalungisa okanye ucime izinto ozifakileyo. Ukuba ucela uZaka ajonge umyalezo, umbhalo unokucutshungulwa yinkonzo yethu ye-AI; susa ii-PIN, iikhowudi zexesha elinye neenkcukacha zeakhawunti kuqala. UZaka akathumeli mali kwaye akagqibi ukuba uyakufanelekela na ukufumana ityala. Qhubeka kuphela xa uvuma.
consent_points_2: Asisoze sikubuze i-PIN, i-OTP okanye igama lokugqitha lebhanki.
consent_points_3: Ungacima yonke into kwisikrini esithi Mna.
onb_money_hint: Imali esepokothweni kunye neyas ebhankini. Uqikelelo nje lulungile.
onb_income_hint: Khetha konke oku kusebenzayo. Siza kufunda nakwizinto ozifakayo.
onb_costs_hint: Sifaka kwangaphambili oko sikwaziyo. Guqula naliphi na inani libe lelakho.
mode_bus: Ibhasi (MyCiTi, Rea Vaya, A Re Yeng…)
queued: Igciniwe kule foni — iza kuvumelaniswa xa ukwi-intanethi.
shortfall_moved: Usuku lokunqongophala kwemali lutshintshile ukusuka ku-{from} ukuya ku-{to}.
shortfall_cleared: Ngoku akuqikelelwa ukunqongophala kwemali kwiintsuku ezili-14 ezizayo.
conf_why_low: Akukabikho iintsuku ezili-14 okanye izinto ezi-6 ezifakiweyo.
conf_why_high: Iintsuku {days} zembali, izinto ezi-{count}, kunye nendlela ebonwe izihlandlo ezi-3 okanye ngaphezulu.
safe_none: Akukho mali ikhuselekileyo yokuchitha ngaphambi ko-{date}. Iimfuno ezibalulekileyo ziza kuqala.
tight_body: Ngeli zinga imali yakho ingaphela ngaphambi kokuba kufike imali elandelayo. Faka imali oyilindeleyo okanye utshintshe intlawulo ukuze uhlaziye oku.
ins_monthly_income: {source} yakho emalunga ne-{amount} idla ngokufika malunga nomhla we-{day} enyangeni — ibonwe izihlandlo ezi-{count}.
ins_recurring_weekly: {source} emalunga ne-{amount} idla ngokufika ngee-{weekday} — ibonwe izihlandlo ezi-{count}.
ins_piece_jobs: Ufumanela malunga nemisebenzi yethutyana eyi-{perWeek} ngeveki, idla ngokuba malunga ne-{amount}.
ins_tight_day: Imali idla ngokuxinana kakhulu malunga nomhla we-{day} enyangeni.
ins_busy_weekday: {weekday} idla ngokuba lolona suku uchitha kakhulu ngalo (malunga ne-{amount}).
ins_shortfall_gap: Malunga ne-{amount} eyongezelelekileyo kwiintsuku ezili-14 ezizayo ingavala umsantsa oqala ngo-{date}.
plan_horizon_income: Uqikelelo luphela kwimali elandelayo ekunokwenzeka ifike ({source}, {date}).
plan_horizon_cap: Akukho mali ilindelekileyo kwiintsuku ezili-14 ezizayo, ngoko sicwangcisa zonke iintsuku ezili-14.
plan_low_path_note: Uqikelelo olulumkileyo: imali enokwenzeka ibalwa ngesiqingatha; enokwenzeka kuphela ayibalwa. Ungatshintsha lonke inani.
goal_daily: Beka malunga ne-{amount} bucala ngosuku ukuze ufikelele kuyo ngo-{date}.
scam_intro: Ncamathelisa iSMS, iWhatsApp okanye i-imeyile. UZaka uqala ayijonge kule foni ukuze afumane iimpawu eziqhelekileyo zobuqhophololo.
scam_low_body: Oku akuthethi ukuba ukhuselekile. Ukuba ucela imali okanye iinkcukacha, ziqinisekise ngokwakho kuqala.
scam_explain_failed: Asikwazanga ukuchaza ngoku. Iimpawu zesilumkiso ezingasentla zisasebenza.
scam_not_stored: Umyalezo wakho awugcinwa. Sigcina kuphela iimpawu zesilumkiso ezifunyenweyo.
flag_otp_pin: Ucela i-PIN, i-OTP okanye igama lokugqitha
flag_too_good: Ivakala intle kakhulu ukuba ingaba yinyani

flag_new_number: Ibali elithi “inombolo entsha” okanye usapho lusengxakini
flag_personal_info: Ucela iinkcukacha ze-ID, zekhadi okanye zeakhawunti
loan_intro: Faka imiqathango ebhaliweyo yombolekisi. UZaka uyidibanisa ngeerandi.

me_delete_confirm: Oku kucima iakhawunti yakho nazo zonke izinto ozifakileyo. Akunakubuyiselwa. Chwetheza DELETE ukuze uqinisekise.
me_reset_demo_note: Ibuyisela iiveki ezili-10 zedatha eyenziweyo kaLerato, ziphele namhlanje.
me_about_body: UZaka wakhiwe yiJustIT Solutions. Zonke izibalo zenziwa yikhowudi kwifoni yakho kwaye ziboniswa ku-“Kutheni olu luqikelelo?”. I-AI isetyenziswa kuphela ukufunda isivakalisi osichwethezayo nokuchaza iimpawu zesilumkiso zobuqhophololo.
me_offline_cache: Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi: isicwangciso sakho sokugqibela nezinto ezintsha zigcinwa kule foni.
error_generic: Kukho into engahambanga kakuhle. Izinto ozifakileyo zikhuselekile kule foni.
logout_pending: Izinto ezi-{count} zisalindele ukuvumelaniswa kwaye ziya kulahleka xa uphuma ngoku. Uphume kunjalo?

loan_simple_interest_note: Apha inzala ibalwa kuyo yonke imali yexesha lonke. Ukuba ubuyisa ngezavenge, ixabiso olinikwe linokuba lincinci.
loan_rate_needed: Faka izinga lenzala elikwikowuti ebhaliweyo ukuze ulithelekise nowona mlinganiselo usemthethweni.
